docs.installCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@12.8.1 --activate && corepack pnpm@12.8.1 install --frozen-lockfile --filter '{.}...' --include-workspace-root
docs.buildCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/corepack && corepack enable --install-directory /tmp/corepack pnpm && corepack prepare pnpm@12.8.1 --activate && export PATH="/tmp/corepack:$PATH" && corepack pnpm@12.8.1 exec turbo run build --filter=docs
docs.ignoreCommand: npx -y turbo@2.11.5 query affected --packages docs --exit-code ${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:+--base $VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA} >/dev/null; test $? -eq 0
